title: The 5 Largest Lakes on Earth, Ranked (#1 Is Called a Sea)

scenes.text: The five largest lakes on Earth, ranked. Number one is not even called a lake.

scenes.label: Lake Michigan · 58,000 km²
scenes.text: Number five: Lake Michigan. About fifty-eight thousand square kilometers, and the only Great Lake fully inside one country.

scenes.label: Lake Huron · 59,600 km²
scenes.text: Number four: Lake Huron. About fifty-nine thousand six hundred square kilometers, shared by the United States and Canada.

scenes.label: Lake Victoria · 69,500 km²
scenes.text: Number three: Lake Victoria in Africa. About sixty-nine and a half thousand square kilometers, shared by three countries.

scenes.label: Lake Superior · 82,000 km²
scenes.text: Number two: Lake Superior. About eighty-two thousand square kilometers, the biggest freshwater lake by area.

scenes.label: Caspian Sea · 371,000 km²
scenes.text: Number one: the Caspian Sea. Three hundred and seventy-one thousand square kilometers, over four times Superior.

description:
The five largest lakes on Earth, ranked by surface area.
The Caspian Sea is called a sea, but it is a lake, and it covers over four times the area of Lake Superior.
How many of these have you seen?
first_comment: How many of these have you seen? And what should we rank next?
